design_rules: Manipulate relative weighting of base rate versus case-specific evidence, not evidence polarity or evidence diagnosticity.
Hold the hypothesis, prior, evidence valence, and case-evidence force constant within each pair; all downstream case evidence must use the registered moderate force.
Do not use diagnosticity, reliability, specificity, noise, or source-track-record cues in probe or downstream prompt text.
Do not use construct ID, condition IDs, or labels such as prior sensitive or case evidence sensitive in prompt_text.
Probe and downstream pools must use disjoint domains, hypotheses, entities, and templates.

Every probe prompt must be a complete instance of the registered probe_prompt_template. Put every scenario fact, the condition-specific weighting stance, and any response request inside the Scenario block before the terminal suffix.

Every generated probe prompt_text must end with the exact final characters `Continue processing the scenario.`. Use that suffix exactly once as an absolute terminator; append no whitespace, punctuation, answer request, rationale request, response-format instruction, stance instruction, label, or other text after it.

Within each paired probe, keep the wrapper, scenario facts, evidence description, and response format/request identical. The only condition-specific difference may be one weighting clause inside the Scenario block before the suffix: prior_sensitive gives more weight to the stated base rate, while case_evidence_sensitive gives more weight to the case-specific evidence.

Do not place condition-specific wording after the terminal suffix. If a response request is included, place the identical request in both pair members inside the Scenario block before the suffix; never use the suffix as a divider before additional instructions.
Do not infer or alter the preregistered readout sign from generated prose.
rejection_criteria: Reject any probe prompt_text whose final characters are not exactly `Continue processing the scenario.`.

Reject any probe prompt_text that contains the suffix more than once, contains the suffix before its final occurrence, or has any character or text after the suffix, including whitespace, punctuation, answer/rationale requests, response-format instructions, stance instructions, notes, or condition labels.
Reject any probe prompt that omits the registered wrapper or Scenario block, truncates either wrapper, or treats the suffix as a mid-prompt delimiter.
Reject any paired probe when the condition-specific weighting instruction is absent from inside the Scenario block before the suffix or is supplied after the suffix.

Reject any paired probe when the wrapper, scenario facts, evidence, response request, response type, answer format, answer choices, output order, or request wording differs across conditions except for the single intended weighting clause.

Reject any paired probe when a condition-specific clause changes the prior, hypothesis, evidence valence, evidence strength, numerical facts, entity, domain, or any other nuisance factor, or when it mentions both weighting conditions.
Reject any prompt containing a construct name, condition ID, or forbidden label such as prior sensitive or case evidence sensitive.

pair_quality_checks.condition_instruction_location: inside Scenario block before terminal suffix

paired_response_format.location: inside Scenario block before terminal suffix

reject_if: any character or text follows the terminal suffix
the suffix occurs more than once
the condition-specific weighting clause is outside the Scenario block
the response request or format differs across pair members
facts or nuisance factors differ across pair members

behavior_factor_schedule.note: Cross prior_probability and evidence_valence independently while holding case-evidence force at moderate; use two independent variants per prior-by-valence cell.
behavior_factor_schedule.balance_check: Each prior-by-valence combination appears twice per behavior and steering content pool; evidence strength is always moderate.

cells.instructions: Generate the configured number of matched reasoning pairs. Hold the prior, case evidence, valence, strength, hypothesis, domain facts, entities, sentence structure, and response request/format constant within each pair. Vary only one condition-specific weighting clause inside the Scenario block: prior_sensitive gives more weight to the stated base rate, while case_evidence_sensitive gives more weight to the case-specific evidence. Use the identical wrapper and response request in both members, and place any response request before the terminal suffix. Each prompt must be a complete probe_prompt_template instance ending with `Continue processing the scenario.` exactly once as its final characters; append no whitespace, punctuation, answer, rationale, response-format instruction, stance instruction, condition label, or other text after the suffix. Do not put the stance clause after the suffix or change any nuisance fact.

Generate matched validation pairs in new hypotheses and domains. Preserve all evidential nuisance factors, entities, sentence structure, and the response request/format exactly within each pair. Change only one weighting clause inside the Scenario block before the terminal suffix: one member gives more weight to the stated base rate and the other gives more weight to the case-specific evidence. Use the identical wrapper and response request in both members. Require `Continue processing the scenario.` exactly once as the final characters; reject any suffix followed by whitespace, punctuation, answer, rationale, response-format instruction, stance instruction, label, or other text, and reject any stance instruction placed after the suffix.

Generate final held-out matched pairs using domains and templates unused by train and validation. Keep the complete wrapper, all numerical/evidence facts, hypothesis, entities, sentence structure, and response request/format identical across the pair. The only allowed condition-specific text is one weighting clause inside the Scenario block before the terminal suffix: base-rate emphasis for prior_sensitive or case-evidence emphasis for case_evidence_sensitive. End every complete prompt with `Continue processing the scenario.` exactly once as the final characters; do not append any text or whitespace after the suffix, and never use the suffix as a divider before a stance, answer, rationale, or formatting request. Do not reveal construct or condition labels.

Generate independent posterior-judgment items with the registered moderate case-evidence force. Use new hypotheses and domains, record all three metadata fields exactly, and do not ask the model to name the reasoning style.
Generate an independent set distinct from behavior_eval with the same prior-by-valence schedule, registered moderate case-evidence force, and exact metadata fields.

Generate neutral items for within-cell output-variation calibration with an exact likelihood ratio of 1: the observation must be equally likely under the focal hypothesis and alternatives. Keep moderate evidence-strength metadata, do not describe evidence as supporting or contradicting, and do not cue prior-versus-case weighting.
